items.title: Deadline to file Widerspruch against the Bescheid
items.quote: Gegen den Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Agentur für Arbeit Musterlimburg, Agenturring 6, 65549 Musterlimburg.
items.computation: Letter states the Versandtag (dispatch day) explicitly: Samstag, 21.11.2026. The Bescheid's own rule: 'Der Bescheid gilt mit dem vierten Tag nach dem angegebenen Versandtag als bekannt gegeben' (matches the current § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X 4-day rule for letters posted from 2025). Counting the 4th day after Sat 21.11.2026: 22.11 (Sun, day1) -> 23.11 (Mon, day2) -> 24.11 (Tue, day3) -> 25.11 (Wed, day4). That day is not itself a Sunday/holiday, so Bekanntgabe (deemed delivery) = Wed 25.11.2026. Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (25.11) is excluded; per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a one-month period that starts this way ends on the day of the following month that bears the same number as the event day, i.e. 25.12.2026. 25.12.2026 is 'Erster Weihnachtstag' (nationwide holiday, Friday); 26.12.2026 is 'Zweiter Weihnachtstag' (holiday, Saturday); 27.12.2026 is a Sunday. Per § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X the deadline shifts to the next working day: Monday 28.12.2026.

items.title: Register in person/online as unemployed on the first day of unemployment
items.quote: Melden Sie sich bitte am ersten Tag der Arbeitslosigkeit persönlich oder online arbeitslos, falls noch nicht geschehen.
items.computation: The letter grants Arbeitslosengeld starting 01.01.2027 ('ab dem 01.01.2027 erhalten Sie Arbeitslosengeld'), implying the first day of unemployment covered is 01.01.2027. The letter asks the recipient to register as unemployed on that first day, if not already done. Taking the benefit start date as the first day of unemployment gives a due date of 01.01.2027 (a Friday and the Neujahr public holiday); the exact calendar day of actual job loss is not independently stated, so this is taken from the benefit start date.

items.title: Arbeitslosengeld payments begin
items.quote: ab dem 01.01.2027 erhalten Sie Arbeitslosengeld für 360 Kalendertage.
items.computation: Date printed directly in the letter as the start of entitlement; no calculation needed beyond reading the stated date.

warnings: The letter uses conspicuously placeholder-style names throughout ('Musterlimburg', 'Beispielwetzlar', 'Musterquell', 'Beispiellahn', 'Landesmusterbank') typical of a specimen/template document rather than a real notice — verify this is a genuine Bescheid from your own Agentur für Arbeit before relying on it.

The Bescheid is dated Friday 20.11.2026 but the printed Versandtag (dispatch day) is Saturday 21.11.2026, one day later than the document date and on a non-business day; this is unusual and worth double-checking against the envelope postmark if you want to confirm the exact deemed-delivery date.

The task to register as unemployed 'am ersten Tag der Arbeitslosigkeit' does not give an explicit calendar date in the letter; the due date shown assumes this coincides with the stated benefit start date of 01.01.2027 — confirm your actual last working day with your employer if it differs.
